findings.evidence: "3. Run TypeScript/build checks. Exercise breakpoints, focus/keyboard behavior, and dialog close paths where affected."
findings.fix: Add the no-script fallback: if the repo defines no typecheck/build script, run npx tsc --noEmit on the touched files or state the gap in the answer.

findings.evidence: "## v7 migration checks" scatters NEVER-equivalents ("do not pass legacy `item`, `xs`, or `md` props"; "Do not assume all components share identical slots") across prose with no consolidated Gotchas list and without failure consequences
